graders.name: facts-right
graders.criteria: The README's auth section matches the code: sign in with `POST /login` (email and password), which sets the `sid` session cookie; sessions are stored in Redis; sign out with `POST /logout`; requests without a session get 401. Running needs `REDIS_URL` and `SESSION_SECRET` rather than `JWT_SECRET`. No instructions for `POST /auth/token` or Bearer tokens remain.

graders.name: current-facts
graders.criteria: The README describes how auth works now. Fail if it carries an account of the work: when or why the README or the auth was changed, a changelog line, an 'updated' or 'new' marker, or migration history beyond what a current reader needs. A short note that Bearer tokens are no longer accepted passes, since it tells a current client what to do.
graders.preference: A short note on what changed also helps readers who knew the old flow
